scope: Runtime-authored AC1027 ASCII and binary DXF sources each contain a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE with unique Boolean-coded groups 290 through 298. Each isolated transaction flips exactly one typed field, including both false-to-true and true-to-false cases across the nine codes. All other typed payload fields and raw body groups remain source-matched.

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The record must be uniquely reachable from the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary and match its captured raw body and immutable baseline. Exactly one existing group among 290-298 may change; its raw source value must match the parsed Boolean and the selected value is necessarily 0 or 1. Identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must remain source-equal.
contract.projection: Replace only the selected existing physical group in a copy of the captured body. Emit it through the Boolean BodyWriter path and retain the raw integer carrier used by DRW_Variant. Preserve other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated groups, raw/typed conflict, simultaneous edits, non-AC1027 routes and other fields remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: For each group 290-298, the focused test checks an exact unique output group value, fresh typed readback, same-format output, and opposite-format output/readback. ASCII and binary source/output cross-products are covered. Runtime-generated source DXFs are created from scratch in temporary storage; no drawing fixture is committed.
contract.failureAndRetry: For each group, changing the raw source value to conflict with the typed request refuses before replacing a sentinel destination. Restoring the original raw body permits the same adapter instance to retry successfully. Boolean members cannot represent an out-of-domain typed value; all selected values are Boolean and the source raw value is checked against its parsed baseline.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE bodies continue raw replay. This transaction is source/target AC1027-only and permits one selected field per record. DWG-origin writing and consumer support claims are unchanged. Group 298's local field role remains separately qualified from the Autodesk-published group-specific rows.

limitations: Evidence qualifies the selected one-field AC1027 transactions only. It does not prove independent producer variation, field behavior in native CAD applications, cross-version validity, DWG editing, full MLEADERSTYLE schema support, annotation behavior or complete document closure.
